verdict.rationale: cubic offers codebase-wide context via AI wiki indexing, codebase scans deploying many agents across the repo, and per-repo cubic.yaml/custom-agent configuration, which supports coherent understanding of large single repos; however there is no evidence of cross-repository awareness, multi-repo dependency tracking, or monorepo-specific handling for changes spanning multiple repos. missing for 10: explicit multi-repo/cross-repository review coherence, monorepo-specific scoping or partitioning features, and independent evidence of large-scale codebase understanding accuracy.
